exposure: fetal presentation at admission (cephalic vs. non-cephalic)
outcome: discordant fetal presentation at delivery (spontaneous version)
cohort: 209 women with singleton pregnancies and PPROM prior to 34 weeks' gestation
finding: Discordant fetal presentation after PPROM occurred in 11.7% of those with initial cephalic presentation and 21.3% with initial non-cephalic presentation.
mod_finding: Spontaneous version after PPROM can impact the mode of delivery, with some women experiencing a change in fetal presentation from cephalic to non-cephalic or vice versa.
